# Events

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_reference.py from crates/dynamoxy-core/src/events.rs and
     python/dynamoxy/events.py. Do not edit. -->

Every event is logged to the `dynamoxy.<category>` logger (the part of the kind before the dot)
at its default level, and delivered to hooks registered with `client.on(pattern, hook)`.
Log records carry the event as `record.dynamoxy`. Change levels or disable kinds with
`dynamoxy.LoggingConfig`. `dynamoxy events` prints this list for the installed version.

| Kind | Logger | Default level | Emitted by | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `request.retry` | `dynamoxy.request` | info | core | A request failed with a retryable error and will be retried after a delay. |
| `request.throttled` | `dynamoxy.request` | warning | core | DynamoDB throttled a request (ProvisionedThroughputExceeded, ThrottlingException, RequestLimitExceeded). |
| `request.gave_up` | `dynamoxy.request` | error | core | A request still failed with a retryable error after the last attempt. |
| `request.outcome_unknown` | `dynamoxy.request` | warning | core | A write may have been applied (an attempt timed out, lost its connection or got a 5xx), and no answer settled whether it was: it was not sent again, or the next attempt's answer may be the earlier attempt's doing. |
| `request.slow` | `dynamoxy.request` | warning | core | A request took longer than slow_operation_threshold. |
| `batch.unprocessed` | `dynamoxy.batch` | info | core | A batch request returned unprocessed items or keys; they are sent again. |
| `batch.incomplete` | `dynamoxy.batch` | error | core | Unprocessed batch items or keys remained after batch_max_rounds rounds. |
| `table.created` | `dynamoxy.table` | info | core | A table was created. |
| `table.updated` | `dynamoxy.table` | info | core | A table's settings or indexes were updated. |
| `table.deleted` | `dynamoxy.table` | info | core | A table was deleted. |
| `client.connected` | `dynamoxy.client` | info | Python | The client connected to DynamoDB (or created its in-memory backend). |
| `client.closed` | `dynamoxy.client` | info | Python | The client was closed. |
| `operation.succeeded` | `dynamoxy.operation` | debug | Python | An operation succeeded (operation, table, duration, attempts, consumed capacity, item counts). |
| `operation.failed` | `dynamoxy.operation` | info | Python | An operation failed (operation, table, error code, attempts). |
| `hook.failed` | `dynamoxy.hook` | error | Python | An event hook raised an exception (the operation was not affected). |
| `events.dropped` | `dynamoxy.events` | warning | Python | Core events were dropped because the event buffer was full. |
